maria: Heads up — after the IdP tweak this morning we're seeing a SCIM provisioning loop for several users. Provisioning fails, then retries, then succeeds with the wrong RBAC (gets assigned "viewer"). KMS logs show repeated Decrypt failures for the SAML payload.  

maria: Error from our KMS trace: "InvalidCiphertextException: Decryption failed (ciphertext truncated)" — looks like the EncryptedAttribute carrying group/roles got corrupted in transit.

maria: Sample SAML response excerpt (base64 decoded, truncated):
```
<samlp:Response ...>
  <EncryptedAssertion>
    <xenc:EncryptedData>
      <CipherData>
        <CipherValue>MIIBIjANBgkqh...ABCD...==</CipherValue>  <!-- note: real value was cut off here -->
      </CipherData>
    </xenc:EncryptedData>
  </EncryptedAssertion>
</samlp:Response>
```

akshay: Oof. Two quick checks: 1) did the IdP recent change enable HTTP-POST compression or a proxy that could truncate large POST bodies? 2) are we hitting any proxy/nginx buffer limits on the SP side that could chop off the tail?

akshay: If the CipherValue is missing padding or suffix bytes we'll see exactly that KMS InvalidCiphertext error. Try decoding the raw SAML response we receive and compare length vs what the IdP sends.

olivia: Also check client_max_body_size / proxy_buffer_size / proxy_busy_buffers_size on the ingress. We hit similar with SAML assertions that had big encrypted attributes (group lists) — nginx default buffers sometimes drop the end when proxying to the app.

olivia: Quick command to capture the raw POST at the SP ingress: `tcpdump -w saml.raw -s 0 port 443 and host <idp-ip>` then `openssl base64 -d` the SAMLResponse param.

aaron: From infra side — I see a coincident change in the idp-proxy config earlier: `proxy_buffer_size` lowered to 4k in the chart release. That would explain truncation. Rolling back now.

maria: Thanks. Curious if KMS key alias rotation could also cause InvalidCiphertext? I can’t find any DecryptDenied errors, only InvalidCiphertext.

aaron: Alias rotation produces AccessDenied or IncorrectKeyException if wrapped key doesn't match. InvalidCiphertext means the ciphertext is malformed, not wrong key. So it's almost certainly truncation/corruption.

akshay: Another thing to check — some IdPs (okta/azure) will URL-encode the SAMLResponse and upstream proxies may double-decode/strip trailing `=` padding characters. That can break base64. Verify that there isn't a middleware that does `urldecode` twice.

maria: Good call. We found a tiny middleware (legacy telemetry) that runs `decodeURIComponent` on all incoming form fields before the request hits auth. It was added months ago but might only show up for longer payloads.

olivia: Action items: 1) rollback proxy buffer change (aaron) 2) disable the legacy decode middleware for /sso/acs (maria) 3) run a replay test of a large assertion from IdP and verify KMS decrypt succeeds (akshay) 4) pull KMS CloudTrail entries for Decrypt on key alias `alias/redwood-saml` for the timeframe (aaron).

deploy-bot: deploy started: chart/idp-proxy rollback to 2026-03-21T10:11:00Z — CI status: green. :rocket:

aaron: CloudTrail quick grep: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt --max-results 50 | jq '.Events[] | select(.EventTime >= "2026-03-21T10:00:00Z" and .EventTime <= "2026-03-21T10:20:00Z")'` — filter for InvalidCiphertext entries under `errorMessage`.

maria: We will also add an audit check in our RBAC pipeline: if the `roles` attribute is missing/empty, fail provisioning instead of defaulting to viewer. That should prevent silent privilege regressions during SSO issues.

akshay: Good plan. Also add a monitoring alert on `saml_response_size` and a KMS decrypt error rate alert so we catch recurrence earlier.

maria: For the incident record: root cause = proxy/middleware combo truncated SAML encrypted attribute (ciphertext), causing KMS InvalidCiphertext -> provisioning created fallback RBAC mapping. Remediation = rolled back proxy buffer reduction, disabled double-decode middleware, added guards in provisioning to fail on missing role attributes, added KMS and saml size alerts.

olivia: Postmortem note: ask IdP to avoid compressing the SAMLResponse (or ensure HTTP POST not compressed) and, long term, consider moving group sync to SCIM with incremental delta rather than embedding large encrypted role lists in assertions.

maria: Thanks all — monitoring looks stable after rollback. Will open a follow-up PR for the provisioning guard and alerts. :white_check_mark:
